text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- More than 2,000 desperate Zimbabwean home-seekers stand to lose thousands of dollars after buying land meant for grazing which was illegally subdivided and sold as individual stands in Epworth, on the outskirts of the capital Harare, in defiance of a High Court order.
- Management at state airliner Air Zimbabwe and representatives of aircraft engineers are scheduled to meet in Harare on Monday in an attempt to end the ongoing strike over salaries by the engineers.
- The Danish government has set aside about Z$220 million to support the decentralisation of Zimbabwe's health system.
